change_summary: DIO pin-control H-bridge motor driver architecture pattern.

key_characteristics.mainfunction_reason: Periodic fault polling and debounce required for motor driver diagnostics

external_apis.name: Gp_DRV887x_Init
external_apis.description: Initializes driver, loads config, sets default mode.

external_apis.name: Gp_DRV887x_MainFunction
external_apis.description: Periodic processing: fault debounce, output request processing.

external_apis.name: Gp_DRV887x_SetHbOutSig
external_apis.description: Sets H-bridge output direction and duty cycle via DIO + PWM pins.

external_apis.name: Gp_DRV887x_GetDevFaultSig
external_apis.description: Returns confirmed fault status from nFAULT pin polling.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_DRV887x_CalloutDioWrite
dependency_apis.description: DIO output for IN1/IN2/nSLEEP control pins. Pin identity resolved via Cfg.c lookup table.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_DRV887x_CalloutDioRead
dependency_apis.description: DIO input for nFAULT status pin.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_DRV887x_CalloutPwmSetDuty
dependency_apis.description: PWM output for motor speed control.

config_macros.name: GP_DRV887X_CFG_FAULT_DEBOUNCE_CNT
config_macros.purpose: nFAULT pin consecutive read count for fault confirmation.

config_params.name: Gp_DRV887x_DioPinMap_au16
config_params.purpose: Maps logical pin index (IN1/IN2/nSLEEP) to physical DIO channel ID.

config_params.name: Gp_DRV887x_PwmChMap_au16
config_params.purpose: Maps PWM channel index to physical PWM channel ID.

runtime_states.name: ModeState_e
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written by Init/SetHbOutSig; read by getters.
runtime_states.lifecycle: Set to UNINIT at load; transitions managed by Init.

runtime_states.name: FaultState + debounce counters
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written by MainFunction; read by GetDevFaultSig.
runtime_states.lifecycle: Zeroed in Init; updated each MainFunction cycle.

memmap_sections.name: RUNTIME RAM
memmap_sections.target_content: Mode state, output request buffer, fault flags, debounce counters.
